cases.acceptance_meaning: Pass only if all material account, country, billing, destination, and measurement gaps remain blockers.
Pass only if economics and sensitivity recompute and account-dependent platform values remain null.
Pass only if every copy claim has fixture proof and missing format, destination, and rights evidence block export.
Pass only if the design remains a feasibility pilot with no sample or causal efficacy claim.
Pass only if the missing day and the stale incomplete day prevent a whole-window pacing decision while comparable complete-day arithmetic remains reproducible.

manual_reviews.scope: A human-readable inspection confirmed that the factual phrases in both drafts are covered by their declared fixture claim IDs. The automated check verifies only the claim-ID allowlist.
The drafts are labeled multi-element concept directions. The experiment case uses one creative for feasibility and requires a future single-factor pair.
